Revenue Structure

The revenue structure for this business is simple. When an item is sold all expenses directly related to that item are deducted then 25% is donated to VOAT, 25% is kept for management and overhead and 50% goes to ProjectVoat to support the overall project. Please note that some of the revenue forwarded to ProjectVoat is earmarked to be donated to VOAT as well and those details are in this thread.

Expenses directly related to a product include the following:

  • The cost of goods sold.

  • Any revenue split paid to affiliates or partners.

  • Commissions paid to creators and / or artists of a specific design.

  • Commissions paid to those that inspired a specific product as noted on the product page.

Business Overview

There are multiple ways this business will be promoted that will be discussed with participants as things progress.
